description: 在 dsh 里装上这个插件即可，无需登录、注册或填 API Key，就能使用包括 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 在内的前沿模型——完全免费，不限量。 All you do is install this plugin in dsh: no login, no sign-up, no API key — the frontier models are just there, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3 among them. Completely free, with no usage cap.
vibe: Ship reviewed code now; let CI sign on main, and never cut a release without an explicit ask.
highlights: Reviewed pull requests must not be blocked by candidate-bound release records or pre-merge signatures.
Code checks are the merge gate; release signing is delegated to the GitHub Actions release-sign workflow after merge.
The release-sign workflow on main is the source of truth for rebuilt and signed release records.
Tags, GitHub Releases, installers, and version bumps require explicit user approval.
Release provenance is separated from code review velocity without weakening release authorization.
assessment: This file shows strong release-process taste: it removes manual signing from the critical path of code review while preserving a verifiable CI-based signing step on main. The explicit prohibition on tags, releases, installers, and version bumps unless requested is a crisp safety boundary that prevents accidental publication. The result is a pragmatic separation between merge velocity and release authority.
